prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1318; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim file for that.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in League City, near the shopping center entrance.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle right away?
A: I got out, but my lower back was tight and I had trouble standing up straight. I sat on the curb for a while.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that afternoon. They checked my back and told me I had a strain.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. Sitting for long periods hurts, and I've been taking time off from my job because bending and lifting make it worse.
Q: Did you have any back problems before this accident?
A: No, not that I can recall. I'd been working normally and had no restrictions.
Q: Has any other provider treated you since then?
A: I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week. They say I should improve with time, but it's slow.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm trying to follow the treatment plan and I want my medical bills and lost wages covered.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thank you.
